domain_hint: Liquid-cooled serpentine cold plate CHT for 6x SiC power modules in an inverter
ambiguity_notes:
- Flow regime handling conflicts: slides cite both SST turbulence and a laminar-only basis with different results.
- Inlet temperature basis inconsistent: 25 C in modeling assumptions vs 30 C in the validation run.
- Mesh usage contradiction: grid study favors medium/fine, but production sweeps executed on the coarse grid.
- Energy balance discrepancy: <0.5% reported for baseline, 3.1% at stress load with same controls.
- Calibration vs validation separation blurred: TIM resistance value changed midstream; another slide claims “no case-by-case retuning”.
- Two different P95 outcomes for Tmax (101 C vs 107 C) under seemingly similar variability assumptions.
- Interface resistance values differ between early scoping (2.5e-4 m2-K/W) and “current runs” (1.5e-4 m2-K/W) without full reconciliation.
